# Knowledge 2.0.0
Control relationship positioning directly with the mouse: move attachments, reconnect endpoints, add and move bends, slide right-angle segments, adjust curves and loops, and position labels independently. The inspector also provides precise numeric controls, route styles, and reset actions.
- Clearer node titles and automatic title fitting, with manual sizing preserved. - Faster large-graph interaction and complete routed content in PNG/PDF exports. - A resizable, collapsible assistant panel; bounded startup discovery and reliable cancellation. - More reliable undo, external commands, validation, and export overwrite handling.
**Document compatibility:** existing format-1 documents open normally. Saving writes format 2, which Knowledge 1.x cannot open. Keep a copy of documents that must remain usable in an older version.
Requires macOS 15 or later; supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
Verification: 38 core tests, 5 app tests, 9 UI tests, and both application self-tests passed. Mouse interactions and light/dark appearance were checked. VoiceOver and complete-frame performance targets remain unverified.
